description: Issue 1207: analytic vs mc-sampled mosaic on HOPG (30 keV, 2 um, 45/180 deg; #1142 t2 baseline transport regenerated on the stated source), intrinsic source spectra only (no detector response). Reference per transport seed = mean density of K=256 x 4 independent mosaic shifts 1207101-4; ladder arms K in {1,4,16,64,256} share shift 1207001. 'analytic' = perfect-crystal intrinsic spectrum convolved with the analytic route's mosaic-only Gaussian (results.store_result width min(E_pk|tan psi|eta, E_pk); EDS/aperture excluded). 'perfect' = the analytic route's intrinsic spectrum. Fourier bin-mean 0.1875 eV on 500-10000 eV. Metrics/margins: checks/defaults_spectral_gate_642.py metrics()/versus()/MARGINS. Statistics are mean [min, max] over transport seeds. Cost is the first transport seed (first call + one warm call); setup is outside the call.
analysis: scratch/analyze_1207.py (copied beside the evidence as source/analyze_1207.py)
